description: One arithmetic formula \(A(\bar x)\) numeralwise represents a relation \(R\subseteq\mathbb N^k\) in \(Q\) if, for every numerical tuple \(\bar a\), a true instance has a \(Q\)-proof of \(A(\overline{\bar a})\), and a false instance has a \(Q\)-proof of its negation.
